name: Somchai Srisuk
bio:
Somchai Srisuk's journey into motorsport began, rather unusually, with a fascination for kites. He saw in their flight the same principles that govern airflow over a racing car. This unconventional entry point led him to pursue engineering, specializing in aerodynamics. After graduating top of his class at Chulalongkorn University, he gained experience at smaller racing teams before making his mark with Elite Motorsport. 

As Head of Aero, Somchai is known for his meticulous approach and unwavering commitment to data analysis. He believes that marginal gains accumulate into significant advantages. He fosters a culture of continuous improvement within his team, always pushing for innovation and optimization. While his demanding nature can be challenging, it's tempered by his deep respect for his team's expertise and his genuine desire to see them succeed. His reliability is legendary within Elite Motorsport; he's the one you want in your corner when deadlines loom.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Somchai is of average height with a serious and focused demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with aerodynamic calculations.
Insists on drinking jasmine tea precisely at 3 PM every day.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
